form.label: VMware Overview
form.description: Recorded VMware events. Diagnostic service messages are excluded from audit panels. Counts deduplicate forwarded copies; latest activity fields come from one event. Default window: 24 hours.

search.query: `vmware_vision_audit` | `vmware_vision_unique` | search vcenter=$vc|s$ | bin _time span=1h | stats count AS events by _time category vmware_action

`vmware_vision_audit` | `vmware_vision_unique` | search vcenter=$vc|s$ | stats dc(vm_key) AS vms count(eval((vmware_action="created" OR vmware_action="cloned") AND status="success")) AS created count(eval(vmware_action="deleted" AND status="success")) AS removed count(eval(status="failure")) AS failures

div.p: Who changed what, and when. Counts reflect unique recorded events in the selected window. State is last observed, not live inventory.

search.query: search category IN (lifecycle,power,configuration,migration,snapshot) | timechart span=1h sum(events) by vmware_action limit=12
stats sum(events) AS count by category | sort - count

`vmware_vision_audit` | `vmware_vision_unique` | search vcenter=$vc|s$ | where len(vm_key)>0 | sort 0 - _time - event_id | dedup vm_key | head 200 | rename _time AS last_seen | table vcenter vm_key last_seen vm_name vmware_action user status message | convert ctime(last_seen)

`vmware_vision_audit` | `vmware_vision_unique` | search vcenter=$vc|s$ | search category IN (configuration,lifecycle,power,migration,snapshot,security) | stats count dc(vm_key) AS VMs by user | sort - count
`vmware_vision_audit` | `vmware_vision_unique` | search vcenter=$vc|s$ | search status=failure | sort 200 - _time | table _time vcenter vm_name user event_type message
